title: Make the Prefix Sum Non-negative
summary: Given a 0-indexed integer array nums, you can perform operations to make its prefix sum array non-negative.
statement: Given a 0-indexed integer array nums, you can perform operations to make its prefix sum array non-negative. An operation consists of selecting any element and moving it to the end of the array. Determine the least number of such operations needed.
constraints: One operation removes any element and appends it to the end.
All prefix sums in the final order must be non-negative; a solution is guaranteed.
Return the minimum number of operations.
hints: Scan the original order and track its running sum.
Keep every negative value seen so far in a min-heap.
When the sum becomes negative, defer the most negative available value; this restores the most capacity with one move.
Each forced repair is necessary, and choosing the largest-magnitude negative leaves the best possible prefix for later positions.
editorial: Each forced repair is necessary, and choosing the largest-magnitude negative leaves the best possible prefix for later positions.

tests.explanation: The prefix sums are already 2, 5, 0, and 4, so no move is needed.
Moving negative five to the end produces non-negative prefix sums in one operation.
